_approach: The broken-beat (bruk) strand of the genre's lineage: the kick stays perfectly steady and never breaks, but the snare/rim answer is chopped into frenetic, syncopated broken-beat hits (the choppy, off-grid rhythm language of the Bugz in the Attic/IG Culture school) rather than a straight backbeat, with congas and shaker filling the gaps in call-and-response. Ref: Wikipedia's broken beat entry (syncopated, frenetic, jazz-funk-adjacent rhythms), Wikipedia's UK funky entry naming broken beat among its direct ancestors. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
